entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Revisionist :- Rateesh Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Kuldeep Kumar Gupta
Hon'ble Mrs. Jyotsna Sharma,J.
1. Heard Sri Rateesh Singh, learned counsel for the revisionists, Sri Kuldeep Kumar Gupta, learned
counsel for the opposite party no. 2 and Sri Chhavi Pal Singh, learned Aga for the State.
2.

By means of this criminal revision the revisionists have challenged the order dated 30.09.2022 passed by the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Sadabad, District Hathras in case no. 3176 of 2014 (Malti vs. Praveen and Others) under Sections 323, 504, 506, 498A IPC and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Sadabad, District Hathras, whereby an application given on behalf of the revisionists/appellants accused persons under Section 245(2) Cr.P.C. has been dismissed.
3.

entities.text: Chief Judicial Magistrate, Sadabad, District Hathras
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Admittedly the application which came to be dismissed was moved on behalf of the revisionists under the provisions of Section 245(2) Cr.P.C. which says that the Magistrate is empowered to discharge the accused persons in case he considers the charge to be groundless; The next stage of framing of charge comes thereafter.

Section 246 Cr.P.C. says that in case on the basis of the evidence led by the complainant, the Magistrate is of the opinion that there is ground for presuming that the accused has committed an offence triable under this Chapter, he shall frame in writing a charge against the accused.
4. Surprisingly, the appellant accused persons have already been charged in this case as is quite clear from the copy of the charge available on record (paper no. 65).

The learned trial court in its Praveen Kumar And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/142374286/
1 order has referred to this fact that the accused persons stand charged and therefore the grounds taken by them can only be considered at the time of final disposal of the case and that the case shall proceed further as per the provisions of Section 246 Cr.P.C.
5.

entities.text: Praveen Kumar And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In my view, there was no occasion to move a discharge application after framing of charge.
There is no merit in this revision, therefore it is dismissed.
